faq.question: Which institution is this?
faq.answer: This is Quaid-E-Millath Government College for Women on Anna Salai, Chennai, affiliated to the University of Madras. Similarly named men’s colleges and colleges elsewhere have separate admissions.

faq.question: Who can apply for these undergraduate routes?
faq.answer: These entries cover women applying through the regular domestic first-year undergraduate route. Meet the exact school-subject, age, category and document-verification requirements for the selected programme.

faq.question: How do I choose a shift or medium?
faq.answer: Select the exact programme and shift in the government admission process. Some subjects have separate Tamil and English sections; where a teaching-language label is absent, confirm it with the college before applying.

faq.question: What school qualification is required?
faq.answer: Pass Higher Secondary or a recognised equivalent in all subjects. Mathematics, science and commerce degrees have specific subject requirements; language degrees also use the applicable language-mark ranking priorities.

faq.question: What are the age conditions?
faq.answer: For the 2026 government admission cycle, the UG upper age is 40 as of 1 July 2026. The named categories and women may receive a three-year relaxation, while disability and transgender provisions allow five years; the college assesses the applicable category.

faq.question: How are admissions decided?
faq.answer: Government merit ranking, reservation rules, counselling and original-document checks apply. A place on a rank list or attendance at counselling does not guarantee admission.

faq.question: What documents should I prepare?
faq.answer: Prepare the application, school marksheets, transfer and relevant community certificates, medical certificate, Aadhaar and photographs. Bring the specified originals and attested copies, plus proof for any claimed special quota.

faq.question: What do the displayed fees cover?
faq.answer: The fee amounts are combined first-year admission charges for 2026–27, including the listed institutional and other components. They are not isolated annual tuition or a full-course total; confirm the current payable amount and any revised tariff before payment.

faq.question: When are fees payable?
faq.answer: Selected applicants are instructed to pay the admission charges at the college office on the day of admission. Follow the current counselling notice and complete certificate checks before payment.

faq.question: Is hostel accommodation available?
faq.answer: A women’s hostel is listed, but room availability and allocation require separate confirmation. Ask about residence rules, deposits, mess charges and accessibility before making accommodation plans.

faq.question: What practical facilities are available?
faq.answer: Science departments use subject laboratories and computing practicals. Home Science includes food-preparation facilities and a modular kitchen; the practical requirements depend on the chosen degree.

faq.question: What recognition applies?
faq.answer: The UGC autonomous-college register records autonomy for 2023–24 to 2027–28 and affiliation to the University of Madras. Programme-specific professional approval has a separate scope.

faq.question: Can international applicants use these entries?
faq.answer: Current foreign-national, NRI and OCI admission and fee treatment has not been established for these undergraduate entries. Obtain individual qualification and category confirmation before using a domestic application route.

evidence.claimText: Quaid-E-Millath Government College for Women is a public women’s college on Anna Salai in Chennai, affiliated to the University of Madras. Its arts, science and commerce degrees include separate shifts and, for several subjects, Tamil and English sections. Select the exact degree, shift and teaching-language route when applying.

evidence.claimText: The Anna Salai campus combines historic buildings, academic departments and a playground. College activities include NSS, NCC, youth and women-development initiatives, sports and student associations. Regular attendance, departmental practicals and the selected shift shape the weekly timetable. Check the current timetable before arranging travel or other commitments.
evidence.sourceLabel: Quaid-E-Millath college / applicable government or regulator record

evidence.claimText: The college is at 74, Binny Road, Anna Salai, Chennai 600002, Tamil Nadu. Plan the daily journey around the selected shift and any laboratory or assessment sessions. This is the government women’s college using qmgcw.edu.in; similarly named men’s colleges and institutions in other locations have separate admissions.
evidence.sourceLabel: Quaid-E-Millath college / applicable government or regulator record

evidence.claimText: Science courses include laboratory work and practical assessment. Home Science has food-preparation facilities, including a modular kitchen and postgraduate laboratory, while computing programmes include subject-specific practical work. The curriculum also includes skills and extension components. Confirm the practical requirements for the chosen degree; academic participation does not guarantee an internship, job or professional registration.
evidence.sourceLabel: Quaid-E-Millath college / applicable government or regulator record

evidence.claimText: The college has a women’s hostel and a separate warden structure. Academic admission does not establish a hostel place. Ask about current room availability, eligibility, residence rules, accessibility, deposits and mess charges before planning a residential stay. Keep the accommodation budget separate from programme charges.
evidence.sourceLabel: Quaid-E-Millath college / applicable government or regulator record

evidence.claimText: Food, mess and personal living costs are separate from the published academic admission charges. Confirm current meal arrangements, timings, allergy handling and any medical dietary needs before accepting accommodation. Individual dietary provision and a complete hostel or meal tariff require direct confirmation.
evidence.sourceLabel: Quaid-E-Millath college / applicable government or regulator record

evidence.claimText: The college lists anti-ragging, sexual-harassment, grievance and student-welfare mechanisms. Obtain the current reporting procedure and relevant contacts at enrolment, and check residence and travel arrangements for the selected shift. Institutional procedures do not guarantee a particular safety outcome or replace individual health, accessibility and emergency planning.
evidence.sourceLabel: Quaid-E-Millath college / applicable government or regulator record

evidence.claimText: Library and network-resource facilities support academic study, alongside student counselling, career guidance and welfare services.
